attchmntText: Indus Fila Limited has submitted to the Exchange, the financial results for the period ended September 30, 2026.
voiceSummary: Indus Fila Limited announced the approval of its unaudited standalone financial results for the quarter ended September 30, 2026, by its Board of Directors on November 12, 2026. The company reported a net loss of 44.57 lakhs INR for the quarter, compared to a loss of 64.60 lakhs INR in the same period last year. For the six months ended September 30, 2026, the net loss was 110.99 lakhs INR. Revenue from operations stood at 16.94 lakhs INR for the quarter. Total assets were recorded at 1462.02 lakhs INR as of September 30, 2026. The independent auditor issued a review report confirming no material misstatements were identified in the financial results.

attchmntText: Indus Fila Limited has informed the Exchange about Certificate under SEBI (Depositories and Participants) Regulations, 2018
desc: Certificate under SEBI (Depositories and Participants) Regulations, 2018
